manifest.changelog: First catalogued release: the six Rebrickable reference catalogs with per-field renderers (schema config; rows load via the CSV importer).
manifest.name: Rebrickable catalogs
manifest.description: Installs the six Rebrickable reference catalogs (themes, part categories, colors, parts, sets, minifigs) with pre-configured renderers: color swatches for the colors palette, image thumbs for sets + minifigs, year columns formatted as years. Row data is loaded separately via the CSV importer or scripts/seed-rebrickable.mjs.
manifest.author: Cobblr community
manifest.readme_md:
# Rebrickable catalogs

Six reference catalogs sourced from [Rebrickable's public CSV dumps](https://rebrickable.com/downloads/). The bundle ships the **schema config only** - id columns, title columns, image columns, hero swatch for the colors palette, and the right renderer per field.

## Catalogs installed

| Catalog | Rows | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Themes | ~500 | Bionicle, Star Wars, City, etc. |
| Part categories | ~75 | Bricks, plates, slopes, tiles, … |
| Colors | ~280 | Big swatch on every card via `hero_field=rgb` + `hero_renderer=color-hex`. |
| Parts | ~62,000 | Individual LEGO elements. Image enrichment via `inventory_parts.csv.gz` (see seeder). |
| Sets | ~27,000 | Has `img_url` from Rebrickable's CDN. |
| Minifigs | ~17,000 | Has `img_url`; broken URLs fall back to a placeholder. |

## Loading the data

This bundle is the *configuration*, not the rows. To load rows:

```bash
node scripts/seed-rebrickable.mjs
```

The seeder logs in as the demo user, finds the workspace with this bundle installed, and CSV-imports each catalog from Rebrickable's CDN. It runs idempotently - re-running refreshes the rows.

catalogs.name: Rebrickable themes
catalogs.description: LEGO themes - Bionicle, Star Wars, City, Town, Castle, etc. Reference taxonomy; not directly bindable to inventory items (sets reference themes).

catalogs.name: Rebrickable part categories
catalogs.description: Part categories - bricks, plates, slopes, tiles, minifig parts, etc. Reference taxonomy; not directly bindable.

catalogs.name: Rebrickable colors
catalogs.description: Every LEGO color Rebrickable tracks. The card renders a big swatch in the image slot via hero_field=rgb + hero_renderer=color-hex.

catalogs.name: Rebrickable parts
catalogs.description: Individual LEGO parts (~62k rows). image_column points at img_url, populated by the seeder from inventory_parts.csv.gz.

catalogs.name: Rebrickable sets
catalogs.description: LEGO sets (~27k rows). Each has an img_url on Rebrickable's CDN.

catalogs.name: Rebrickable minifigs
catalogs.description: Minifigure catalog (~17k rows). Some img_urls 404 on the CDN - those degrade to a placeholder.

catalogs.name: Rebrickable set inventories
catalogs.description: The set BOM: every (set_inventory, part_num, color_id) tuple with quantity + img_url. ~5M rows. Powers the 'what parts does set X contain' lookup and the 'what am I still missing' restoration workflow. Excluded from the global quick-add typeahead because the row count would drown out the real catalogs. The seeder synthesises a row_id = '<inventory_id>-<part_num>-<color_id>-<is_spare>' column on import so each tuple gets its own external_id.
